_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Du spillst Golf (Kaartespill) - Spiller {player_id}.
Zil: Deen niddregsten Totalpunkte an dëser eenzeger Ronn kréien. Wa Spalte gläich Werte hunn, gi sinn als 0 zesummegezaunt.
Kaartwerte: A=1, 2-10=Uewergesichtswert, J/Q=10, K=0

Aktiounen (benotz genee d'Klameren):
- '[draw]' - Zéien aus dem Deck
- '[take]' - Huelen aus dem Ofgedroen-Haap
- '[swap X Y]' - Ausgetosch Kaart mat Positioun X (Rei) Y (Spalte)
- '[discard]' - Ofgedroen Kaart

board.drew:
Du hues {card} gezunn
Jetzt musst du [swap X Y] oder [discard]
board.took:
You took: {card} from discard pile
You must [swap X Y] with it (cannot discard).

options.final_turns: Final turns! Your options: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: Dir musst: [swap X Y] (kann net Kaarten aus dem Verzichtstapel entlooss)

action_desc.swapped: Spiller {pid} huet {new} mat {old} op Positioun ({row},{col}) ausgetosch

message.deck_empty: Deck ass eidel! D'Spill endet direkt.
message.knocked: Spiller {pid} gekloppt! All anere Spiller kritt eng Kéier méi.
message.final_round: Spiller {pid} {reason}! Jeden aneren Spiller kritt nach eng Kéier

invalid.wrong_action: Benotz genee ENG aktion mat Klameren: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], oder [peek X Y]
invalid.must_draw_first: Du musst éischten [draw], [take], [knock], oder [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Dir kënnt keng Kaart aus dem Réckzuchstapel ewechhuelen. Dir musst se austauschen.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Du hues eng gezunn Kaart. Du musst [swap X Y] oder [discard] se
invalid.need_drawn_swap: Dir braucht eng gezunn Kaart fir ze tauschen.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: Dir braucht eng gezunn Kaart fir ze entsuergen.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Positioun ausserhalb vun de Grenzen. Benotz Rei 1-{max_row}, Spalte 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Dir kënnt net mat enger gezunner Kaart kloppen. Fëllt Ären Tour als éischt aus.
invalid.already_knocked: Someone has already knocked this round.
